sources.name: Iowa Individual Income Tax Withholding Formula, effective January 1, 2026

notes: Read from the official 2026 publication listed in sources on 2026-10-20. Not yet signed off.

Formula: T1 = wages - deduction; T2 = T1 x 3.80%; T3 = T2 - allowance / pay periods. Deduction by pay period (annual: $13,000 other, $19,500 head of household, $26,000 married filing jointly with a non-earning spouse).
'Married' in the calculator means married filing jointly with a spouse who has no earned income. A married earner with an employed spouse should choose single.
Allowance: the guide's examples use $40 per allowance; the 2026 IA W-4 computes the total. Official examples 1-3 ($59.26, $38.72, $45.15) are asserted in tests.
